title: Desktop GUI application (lichen-desktop)
description:
Desktop GUI application for LICHEN using Electron or Tauri.

Features:
- CoAP client for node communication over IPv6
- Contact management with TOFU key pinning
- Message composition and history
- Waypoint management and map display
- Node status and diagnostics
- Cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux)

Technology options:
- Electron: Web tech, larger bundle, mature ecosystem
- Tauri: Rust backend, smaller footprint, native feel

Depends on Local Client Interface (Phase 6) being defined.
